objective: Separate structured-fact augmentation from actual code-for-prompt relation substitution while preserving the unsupervised prompt-reference reconstruction objective.

v1.label: full_graph_augmentation
v1.reason: construct definitions were not transported and response tasks differed

matched_v2.label: full_graph_augmentation
matched_v2.valid_if_run_as: augmentation treatment including token and attention cost

observed_prelaunch_size_confound.interpretation: A full-graph comparison includes representation, token-load, and attention effects.

shared_invariants.construct_transport: exact articulated construct and target-relation definition rendered in every final API payload
shared_invariants.program: same model, decoding, transport, response schema, and aggregation within each contrast

augmentation_microexperiment.unit: one item by one pre-registered target relation

fact_representation.form: compact relation-specific summary, not the full AST graph
must_include: positive event records or bounded aggregate facts
must_exclude: source excerpts beyond the shared ctext

arms.label: prompt_only_relation_control
arms.purpose: baseline articulability for the identical target relation

arms.label: relation_matched_augmentation
arms.fact_block: compact facts whose executable relation matches the target relation
arms.purpose: net augmentation effect including the compact block's token cost

arms.label: equally_deep_relation_mismatched_control
arms.fact_block: compact facts from a different pre-registered CodeScope relation

matching.algorithmic_depth: same parser, scope graph, and relation-extraction stage
matching.serialized_length: deterministically downselect records to the matched block's model-token count; if the frozen tokenizer cannot make counts equal, require the smallest attainable difference and report it before execution
matching.schema_depth: same wrapper depth and coverage metadata
matching.truthful_provenance: the control retains its actual mismatched relation identity

arms.purpose: distinguish relation match from generic structured context and attention load

primary_estimands: relation_matched minus null: total compact-fact augmentation effect
relation_matched minus relation_mismatched_length_matched: relation-specific augmentation effect
relation_mismatched_length_matched minus null: generic structured-context and attention effect
outputs: declared holistic score only as a registered secondary output
prompt-reference reconstruction agreement after all programs are frozen

substitution_microexperiment.label: offline_one_relation_code_substitution
substitution_microexperiment.purpose: Locate the executable seam without changing the LLM prompt task between substitutions.

current_v3_scalar_eligibility.reason: Coverage alone does not establish that a code scalar implements the articulated prompt relation.
current_v3_scalar_eligibility.required_before_substitution: A frozen construct adversary must pass for the exact code value, relation orientation, coverage state, and aggregation role being substituted.

relation_status.placeholder_avoidance: whole_relation_ineligible; exact-surface occurrence is only a code-native subrelation
relation_status.collision_and_shadowing: whole_relation_ineligible; structural event is only a code-native subrelation

steps: Run one prompt-decomposition program that emits every canonical relation score under a frozen aggregation.
Hold all prompt-emitted residual relations fixed.
After the construct adversary passes, replace exactly one covered and construct-matched prompt relation or subrelation value with the frozen code value.
Recompute the same frozen parent aggregation offline.
Repeat one relation at a time; do not refit weights or rerun the LLM in response to results.
substitution_microexperiment.noncoverage: A missing code relation remains null and the substitution is unavailable; neutral 0.5 is never substituted.
substitution_microexperiment.semantic_context_fit: never code-substituted under the current capability

frontier_relations.placeholder_avoidance: Exact-surface occurrence may enter only as a separately modeled code-native subrelation; it cannot replace the contextual-appropriateness relation.
frontier_relations.collision_and_shadowing: A structural event may enter only as a separately modeled code-native subrelation; it cannot replace the harmfulness/readability relation.

substitution_microexperiment.interpretation: Once eligibility is established, this estimates the mechanical program effect of moving one declared relation or subrelation from prompt output to code output. It is substitution, not a correctness claim.
